# Yichuan Wang / Charlie-Wang-03

> Public technical profile of Yichuan Wang (GitHub: Charlie-Wang-03), an Applied Mathematics M.S. student at Fudan University whose public work spans Scientific Machine Learning, AI for Science & Mathematics, AI agents and agent reliability, reproducible research workflows, scientific computing, and open-source engineering.

Use the canonical profile files for identity and current positioning. Use each linked project's own README or upstream pull request for project-specific technical claims. Private repositories and non-public information are outside the scope of this public profile.

## Core profile

- [English public profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/Charlie-Wang-03/main/README.md): Canonical English profile and current public positioning.
- [Simplified Chinese public profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/Charlie-Wang-03/main/README.zh-CN.md): Natural Simplified Chinese companion with the same public facts.
- [Structured public profile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/Charlie-Wang-03/main/PROFILE.md): Compact identity, technical areas, selected work, public activity, academic identifiers, and source boundaries.
- [Schema.org Person metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/Charlie-Wang-03/main/profile.jsonld): Machine-readable public identity and selected-work metadata.

## Selected public work

- [AI4Math Chronicle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/ai4math-chronicle/main/README.md): Evidence-backed, bilingual AI for Mathematics timeline and archive with explicit editorial and verification methodology.
- [Agentic Simulation Lab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/agentic-simulation-lab/main/README.md): Reproducible Ansys-based engineering simulation workflows orchestrated by AI agents and evaluated with explicit physics validation.
- [Sightline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/dsh-sightline/main/README.md): Developer tooling for comparing workspace instruction surfaces across DeepSeek Harness, Codex, and Claude Code.
- [jev-testbench](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Charlie-Wang-03/jev-testbench/main/README.md): Auditable Jev testbench with append-only evidence, preregistered experiments, and a frozen evidence release.

## Open-source contributions

- [DeepMathLLM / Creative-Intelligence](https://github.com/DeepMathLLM/Creative-Intelligence): Upstream work on deterministic regression/integration testing, resumable-workflow provenance, lifecycle integrity, verification, and controller hardening.
- [DeepMathLLM / Moonshine PR #4](https://github.com/DeepMathLLM/Moonshine/pull/4): Open contribution for crash-safe tool execution journaling and interrupted-turn recovery.
- [OpenHands / software-agent-sdk PR #5029](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/pull/5029): Merged contribution normalizing LLM usage telemetry through a typed adapter.
- [mcp-migrate PR #279](https://github.com/dheerajjha/mcp-migrate/pull/279): Merged contribution hardening Python fixer output so comment-out migrations do not leave empty function bodies.
